title: M5GFX #452: restore the Arduino SPI clock source after the ESP-IDF master init (C6 SPI2)

hardware.reason: No ESP32-C6 hardware on this host; physical SCLK not measured.

execution.environment: macOS arm64; local Device Service nesso-n1 profile, runtime=esp32sim (ESP32-C6 / ST7789 135x240 / SPI2 / 16 MB flash)

checks.name: Code-level: IDF 5.5.5 call chain and per-target mux write
checks.observed: spi_bus_add_device -> spi_master_init_driver -> spi_hal_init -> spi_ll_master_init; C6/C61 write sel=1, H2 writes 0, C5 does not write; restore point after add_device covers it.

checks.name: Arduino-only 8 MHz baseline
checks.observed: sel=0 (XTAL 40 MHz), divider 5, derived SCLK 8 MHz on both trees.

checks.name: base 603092a: SPI2 mux after M5GFX bus init
checks.observed: PCR_SPI2_CLKM_CONF=0x00500000, sel=1 (PLL_F80M), derived Arduino 8 MHz becomes 16 MHz and 2 MHz becomes 4 MHz.

checks.name: head e1666e9: SPI2 mux after M5GFX bus init
checks.observed: PCR_SPI2_CLKM_CONF=0x00400000, sel=0 (XTAL), derived Arduino 8 MHz stays 8 MHz and 2 MHz stays 2 MHz; repeat run identical.

checks.name: head: Nesso N1 ST7789 panel init and full-screen write
checks.observed: display_init=1, 135x240, 40 MHz write clock (clk_equ_sysclk=1), frame PNG b9db9630... identical to base.

checks.name: Build: Nesso N1 (3.3.13)
checks.observed: Four 16,777,216-byte merged images built; Device Service flash.verified=true; --warnings all on head produced no new warnings.

checks.name: Build-only: esp32c5 and esp32h2 (3.3.13)
checks.observed: Both targets compiled successfully (PCR div-num and SEL-only macro paths).

checks.name: readRect readback on virtual Nesso N1
checks.observed: esp32sim Nesso N1 model implements RDDID (0x04) only, not RAMRD (0x2E); read back returns 0xFFFF on both trees.

checks.name: C61 build
checks.observed: Local esp32:esp32 3.3.13 has no C61 target; PR CI esp32c61 (IDF 5.5.2) is SUCCESS.

checks.name: C5 / C61 / H2 runtime
checks.observed: No matching creatable device profile on this host.

checks.name: SCLK pin waveform
checks.observed: esp32sim does not model GP-SPI clock frequency; SCLK values are derived from the mux and divider registers.

checks.name: Arduino 4.0 / IDF 6.x runtime
checks.observed: Source comparison only; local core is 3.3.13. PR CI Arduino 4.0.0 / IDF 6.0.2 build is SUCCESS.

notes: Virtual-device validation: SCLK is derived from PCR mux and SPI2 divider registers, not measured on a pin.
Display path uses M5GFX's own Nesso N1 bus/panel parameters; IOE 0x44 LCD_READY/BACKLIGHT is enabled in the sketch because the board model gates panel commands on it.
PR CI includes esp32c61 (IDF 5.5.2) and Arduino 4.0.0 / IDF 6.0.2 targets; local runs cover C6 only.
No blocking issue found. Read clock changes from 16 MHz to 13.3 MHz and use_lock=false caps writes above 40 MHz; both are documented in the PR body.
